name: Surrealist v3.9.0
body:
- Improved designer view to use ALTER statements in 3.x instances
- Overhauled Surrealist design
    - Improved brand icons
    - Redesigned light theme
    - Redesigned sidebar and topbar
    - Added a toggle sidebar button to the topbar
    - Moved settings button to a menu item in the topbar when logged out and account menu when logged in
    - Unified the namespace and database selectors into a single selection menu
    - Completely redesigned connection and instance settings
    - Implemented new search functionality for connections and organisations on the overview page
    - Revamped and re-enabled API Docs view
- Implemented a new datasets browser and data manager (#1224)
- Improved the record inspector with new references and live tabs, and new actions
- Implemented VIM mode setting (#106)
- Implemented the ability to toggle tables in the designer (#372)
- Implemented default namespace and database functionality for 3.x instances
- Implemented namespace and database comment editor
- Added namespace and database comments to selection menu and database settings page
- Added search inputs to the namespace and database selection lists
- Added designer view LOD settings for zoom-based table simplification (#1222)
- Added pagination to the newsletter drawer
- Fixed title bar overlapping drawers on Windows and Linux
- Fixed authentication redirect on session expiry
- Fixed Windows install art not showing for new installations
- Fixed Surrealist mini not allowing datasets other than surreal-deal-store
- Fixed an error where imports always showed success, even when they failed
- Fixed 2.x sample data datasets being applied to 3.x databases
- Fixed explorer returning no rows when sorting on empty columns (#1194)
- Fixed interface and designer zoom not applying on all platforms (#1188)
- Clean up stale graph connections after deleting edge tables (#1147)
- Fixed an issue where clicking a table in designer view would cause a crash (#1238)
- Fixed an issue causing large conection urls to cause UI overflow in connection cards (#1225)
- Fixed broken documentation links (#1217)
- Fixed passing URLs through desktop launcher (#1179)
- Fixed Designer exports including lower LOD levels
- Fixed designer not showing links for complex ids (#1063)
- Fixed UUID records not resolving correctly in graph (#974)
- Fixed clipboard writes failing in some browsers (#994)
- Fixed GraphQL view authentication (#1101)

Compatible with SurrealDB 2.x and SurrealDB 3.x

name: Surrealist v3.8.0
body:
- Navigation experience overhauled
	- Combined the organisations page with the overview page for a more cohesive experience
	- Refreshed the organisation details page with an updated design
	- Resolved an issue where blog posts were not appearing
- Improved namespace and database management
- Added a new query results exporter to export query results in JSON or CSV format
- Added a button to clear live query history
- Added a new and improved query formatting system
- Added a new clear notifications button
- Added a query runtime to the Query view to show how long your whole request has been running
- Resolved an issue where macOS menu bar items were not working
- Resolved non-functioning keybinds on macOS
- Resolved reported crashes in the Designer view
- Resolved Explorer view crashes caused by stale data
- Resolved crashes in the Designer view triggered by graph relations
- Prevented the escape key from exiting full screen on macOS
- Improved syntax highlighting colors in light mode when searching
- Added missing horizontal and vertical scrollbars to the Explorer view
- Stopped record selections from persisting across tables
- Improved scrolling performance with large namespaces and databases
- Ensured decimal points below 0.000 are displayed correctly
- Fixed record IDs incorrectly rendering in light mode when app is in dark mode
- Made sure error messages are properly displayed in the record inspector

Compatible with SurrealDB 2.x and SurrealDB 3.x

name: Surrealist v3.7.4
body:
- The Sandbox now runs in a background worker for improved performance
- Improved namespace and database management
- Fixed user and access method duration inputs
- Fixed spaces not always being inserted in editors

Compatible with SurrealDB 2.x and SurrealDB 3.x

name: Surrealist v3.7.3
body:
- Improved the import and export workflow
	- Redesigned the export modal and introduced missing options
	- Use streamed imports and exports in supported browsers and environments
	- Imports and exports now run in the background and do not block the UI
- Mask nodes in the Designer view when zoomed out (#1151)
- Added the organisation id to the organisation settings tab
- Fixed menus and dropdowns not always appearing readable
- Fixed rounding errors in query duration formatting
- Fixed the Sandbox strict mode setting not being respected
- Fixed reported UI issues

Compatible with SurrealDB 2.x and SurrealDB 3.x
